source: Novo Nordisk press release: Novo's denecimig demonstrates tolerability after switch (09-17-2026)

quarterly_data.quarter: Novo Nordisk press release: Novo's denecimig demonstrates tolerability after switch (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Phase 3b FRONTIER5 results for denecimig, published in the Journal of Thrombosis and Haemostasis: 61 adults and adolescents aged 12 and older with haemophilia A, with or without inhibitors, switched directly from emicizumab to the denecimig pen without a washout period or loading dose and completed 26 weeks. Primary safety endpoint: 107 treatment-emergent adverse events in 43 patients (70.5%), 98.1% mild to moderate, 24 possibly/probably related; no thromboembolic events, hypersensitivity reactions or discontinuations, and no clinical evidence of neutralising anti-denecimig antibodies. Of 59 patients asked, 98.3% rated the pen easy or very easy to use and 96.6% preferred it to their previous method; treatment burden (Hemo-TEM) fell by an average of 4.7 points from a baseline of 10.5. Exploratory: mean peak thrombin generation rose from 25.5 nmol/L at week 0 to 39.8 nmol/L at week 26 (mean of individual changes 78.8%), into the normal range with no excessive clotting, and steady state was reached by week 16 without a loading dose.
